question: Which attendant deities are worshipped on the left and right sides?
premises: Ghoṇā and Jyotiṣmatī are to be worshipped.
They are placed on the left and right sides.
Worship of these attendants is prescribed.
inference: One should worship Ghoṇā and Jyotiṣmatī on the left and right sides.
plain_english: One should also worship Ghoṇā and Jyotiṣmatī on the left and right sides.
